name: M3_MWS423MI_UnpackPicklist
description: Unpack an entire picking list for a delivery. The operation reverses previous pack reporting at pick-list level so that all lines on the specified picking list are set back to an unpacked state and can be repacked or otherwise adjusted.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the pick list is unpacked.

inputParameters.name: DLIX
inputParameters.description: Delivery number identifying the pick list to unpack.

inputParameters.name: PLSX
inputParameters.description: Picking list suffix identifying the specific picking list instance to unpack for the delivery.
